summary: Copilot AI-powered analysis in Dynamics 365 Business Central: users describe what they need and Copilot builds totals, pivots and filters, and they can explore trends and outliers inside Business Central. It works with most Business Central data, including customizations. Short 2024 overview video.
overview:
This one-minute video from the Business Central channel (published 2024-09-03) describes how Copilot helps with data analysis. Business Central already has built-in analysis and reporting, but finding the insights you need takes time. Copilot turns raw data into summaries using AI.

Users describe what they want, and Copilot creates totals, pivots and filters. Trends and outliers can be explored without leaving Business Central. The video says this is available for most Business Central data, including customizations.
key_points: Copilot transforms raw data into insightful summaries using AI.
Users describe what they need and Copilot creates totals, pivots and filters.
Trends and outliers can be explored without leaving Business Central.
Available for most Business Central data, including customizations.
The video frames the goal as faster, data-driven decisions.
